purpose: v030 smooth low-RPM tip-in (ECM 44607 to 2400 RPM & ECM 12163 0.699V to 6.00 lb/h) and enhanced safe decel pops (ECM 44605 to -4/-6 deg ATDC & ECM 44496 DFCO delay to 1.75s)

tune.status: Candidate prepared for owner entry and flash

changes_since_previous_run: Relative to v029: raised [ECM] 44607 Spark Tip-In Torque Control RPM Min from 775 to 2,400 RPM to eliminate low-speed 15-17 deg timing drop oscillations; bumped [ECM] 12163 Column 11 (0.699V) by +6.0% from 5.66 to 6.00 lb/h (0.0944 to 0.1000 lb/min) to bridge the 0.70-0.88V tip-in lean gap; deepened warm decel retard in [ECM] 44605 Rows 4 & 5 to 2.0 deg (2k), -4.0 deg (3k), -6.0 deg (4-6k RPM) for crisper, safe overrun pops; extended [ECM] 44496 DFCO delay from 1.25 to 1.75s (+0.5s burble window). All v029 dashpot decay, DFCO VSS, and MAF 0.90-1.20V cruising calibrations preserved.

profile.filename: profiles/2004 Focus SVT - V023 Idle Spark Trial.Channels.xml
profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls

planned_actions: Stage A: Low-RPM tip-in and low-speed drivability check. In 1st and 2nd gear from 1,200-2,000 RPM, lightly modulate throttle (10-25% pedal) to confirm elimination of the previous hesitation/bucking and verify spark advance stays smooth (no Torque Control cuts below 2,400 RPM).

Stage B: Enhanced overrun decel pop evaluation. Perform in-gear deceleration from 4,500-5,500 RPM down to 2,000 RPM in 2nd or 3rd gear. Verify that crisp, audible sports-car exhaust crackles occur for ~1.5-1.7s before DFCO cut.

Stage C: Steady light-throttle cruising and rolling stop verification. Hold steady 35-45 mph cruise; coast down to 0 mph in neutral/clutch-in to verify that cruising trims remain centered within +-3% and idle settles cleanly at 950 RPM.
Stage D: Boost pull check (optional). Perform a moderate boost pull up to ~6,000 RPM, confirming WGDC remains at 6% with peak boost ~11.5 psi.
stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.5 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Fuel rail pressure collapse (< 35 psi differential)
